skill_name: Describe what makes a successful online business.
workflow: A successful online business requires a few key components. Firstly, customers must be aware of the online business - this requires a strong online presence, such as a website and a marketing strategy. Secondly, customers must be able to easily access the business - this requires the website to be optimized for different devices and browsers, and must provide a secure checkout process.
